commencement.source_text: it shall come into force on the 1st April, 2026

deduction_health_insurance.source_text: Chapter VIII other than the provisions of section 124(1) and 124(2), or 125(2) or 146

deduction_savings_insurance.source_text: Chapter VIII other than the provisions of section 124(1) and 124(2), or 125(2) or 146

age_based_exemption_limits.reason: The Act fixes no age-based basic exemption limit; the rates it charges are those a Central Act enacts for the tax year.
age_based_exemption_limits.source_text: Where any Central Act enacts that income-tax shall be charged for any tax year at any rate or rates

health_and_education_cess.reason: The Act states no cess rate; it refers to cess only as levied under the Central Acts.
health_and_education_cess.source_text: Education Cess on income-tax, if any, as levied under the Central Acts

marginal_relief_on_surcharge.reason: The Act states no surcharge, so it states no marginal relief on one.
marginal_relief_on_surcharge.source_text: Where any Central Act enacts that income-tax shall be charged for any tax year at any rate or rates

old_regime_slabs.reason: The Act prints slabs only for the section 202(1) regime; any other rates are those a Central Act enacts for the tax year.
old_regime_slabs.source_text: Where any Central Act enacts that income-tax shall be charged for any tax year at any rate or rates

surcharge.reason: The Act states no surcharge rate or threshold; it refers to surcharge only as levied under the Central Acts.
surcharge.source_text: surcharge, if any, as levied under the Central Acts

health_insurance_aggregate_cap.source_text: shall not exceed Rs. 50000 in aggregate

health_insurance_senior_citizen_cap.source_text: shall be substituted with Rs. 50000 for Rs. 25000

preventive_health_check_up_cap.source_text: allowed up to Rs. 5000 in aggregate

rebate_new_regime_income_limit.source_text: the income does not exceed twelve lakh rupees

rebate_new_regime_marginal_relief_thresh.source_text: the total income exceeds twelve lakh rupees

rebate_new_regime_maximum.source_text: 100% of the income-tax payable or Rs. 60000, whichever is less

rebate_other_maximum.source_text: 100% of income-tax payable or Rs. 12500, whichever is less

rounding_multiple.source_text: shall be rounded off to the nearest multiple of Rs. 10

senior_citizen_age.source_text: of the age of sixty years or more

standard_deduction_new_regime.source_text:
Rs. 75000 or the salary, whichever is less, where income-tax is
computed under section 202(1)

standard_deduction_other.source_text: Rs. 50000 or the salary, whichever is less, in any other case
